Q065-02.notes: x>3: 2x+2=10 -> x=4; x<-5: -2x-2=10 -> x=-6; between, sum is constant 8. Sum = -2. B -1: no basis (half of -2). C 2: sign error. D 4: only the positive-region solution.

Q065-03.notes: -0.05x^2+2x=0.5x -> 0.05x^2=1.5x -> x=30 (x=0 is the nozzle). A 15: half. B 20: vertex of stream. D 40: where stream returns to y=0 (flat ground).

Q065-04.notes: Let bisector CE. CE||AB gives angle DCE = A = 50 (corresponding) and angle BCE = B (alternate interior), so B=50, BCD=100, ACB=80. A 25: half of A. B 50: confuses ACB with A/B. C 65: (180-50)/2 isosceles trap.

Q065-05.notes: Angle ADC=70 intercepts arc ABC=140, so arcs AB=BC=70, CD=70, arc DA=150. Angle ABD intercepts arc AD (not containing B) = 75. A 35 = angle ADB/ABD-type half of arc AB; B 55 = (180-70)/2 trap; C 70 = angle ADC.

Q065-06.notes: Longer diagonal opposite the 120 deg angle: d^2=25+9-2*15*cos120=49 -> 7.

Q065-07.notes: Heights from P to AB and to CD sum to 10. 5h=18 -> h=3.6; PCD=5*6.4=32 (equivalently PAB+PCD=50). A 18 equal-area trap; B 25 quarter; D 82 = 100-18.

Q065-09.notes: Sides a,a,b with 2a+b=30, b>0, b<2a -> 7.5<a<15 -> a=8..14: 7 triangles (includes equilateral 10,10,10, which is counted once). A 6 excludes equilateral; C 8 boundary error; D 14 double counting.

Q065-11.notes: Symmetry: vertex at t=3.5. Second difference -10 -> a=-5. h(3)=-5(0.25)+k=61 -> k=62.25 (=249/4).

Q065-12.notes: N=500*2^(t/4-t/12)=500*2^(t/6): doubles every 6 h. A ignores the drug factor; C 8 = (4+12)/2; D 16 = 4+12.

Q065-13.notes: q(x)=0 when 2x-1=3 -> x=2. A gives p(1), C gives p(5), D gives p(9) (forward-substitution trap: 2*3-1=5), none known to be 0.

Q065-14.notes: Axis x=4, opens up; value grows with distance from 4. A: dist 4 vs 1, true. B: dist 3 vs 3, equal -> false. C: f(4) is minimum -> false. D: dist 1 vs 4 -> false.

Q065-16.notes: Need x>=0 and x^2-x-k=0 with two nonneg roots: 1+4k>0 and -k>=0 -> -1/4<k<=0. k=-0.2: roots ~0.276, 0.724, both valid. A -0.3: discriminant negative, none. C 0.2 and D 2: one root negative, so one solution.

Q065-17.notes: x^2-2x-k=0, x!=2. Double root: k=-1 (x=1, valid). One root extraneous at x=2: k=0 -> roots 0,2, only x=0 valid. So {-1,0}. A misses k=0; B sign error; C: k=2 gives two valid roots 1+-sqrt3.
